resources.string: Aasra is not a doctor. Call your doctor if this lasts, gets worse, or you feel unsure. For sudden danger, use SOS or local emergency services.
This can be urgent. Sit still, tell someone nearby, and use SOS or local emergency services now. Do not wait for Aasra.

string-array.name: care_fever_steps
string-array.item: Sit or lie down in a cool room. Loosen tight clothes.
Sip water often. Rest. Use a lukewarm cloth on the forehead if it feels hot.
Take only fever medicine your own doctor already gave you, in the way they told you. Do not start a new medicine on your own.
Tell a family member. Call a doctor if the fever lasts more than two days, you feel confused, or breathing is hard.

string-array.name: care_cough_steps
string-array.item: Sit upright. Sip warm water slowly.
Breathe steam from a bowl of hot water if it feels easy. Keep the face a safe distance from the water.
Rest your voice. Avoid smoke and dust.
Call a doctor if the cough lasts many days, there is blood, chest pain, or you cannot catch your breath.

string-array.name: care_cold_steps
string-array.item: Rest. Keep warm, not sweaty.
Drink water or warm fluids through the day.
Blow the nose gently. Sleep with the head a little raised.
Call a doctor if fever is high, the face is very painful, or you feel worse after a few days.

string-array.name: care_headache_steps
string-array.item: Sit in a quiet, dim room. Close the eyes for a few minutes.
Drink a glass of water. Eat a little if you have not eaten.
A cool cloth on the forehead can help. Do not take a new pain tablet unless your doctor already advised it.
Call a doctor or use SOS if the pain is sudden and very strong, you vomit, the neck is stiff, or one side feels weak.

string-array.name: care_stomach_steps
string-array.item: Sit or lie with the knees a little bent. Loosen the belt.
Sip water. Skip heavy, spicy, or oily food for now.
Do not take a new tablet for the pain unless your doctor already told you to.
Call a doctor if the pain is severe, the belly is hard, there is blood, or you cannot keep water down.

string-array.name: care_vomit_steps
string-array.item: Sit up. After vomiting, rinse the mouth with water.
Wait a short while, then sip water slowly. Do not gulp.
Skip food until the stomach settles, then try a little plain food.
Call a doctor if vomiting does not stop, there is blood, or you feel very weak or dizzy.

string-array.name: care_loose_steps
string-array.item: Drink water often, in small sips. Oral rehydration water from a chemist is useful if you have it.
Stay near a toilet. Rest.
Eat light food when you can. Avoid raw, oily, or very sweet food.
Call a doctor if there is blood, high fever, or you cannot drink, or this lasts more than a day.

string-array.name: care_body_steps
string-array.item: Rest the sore part. Sit or lie in a comfortable position.
A warm cloth can ease stiffness. Move slowly after rest.
Take only pain medicine your doctor already gave you, as they told you.
Call a doctor if one side is weak, the chest also hurts, or you cannot walk.

string-array.name: care_dizzy_steps
string-array.item: Sit or lie down at once. Do not stand up quickly.
Sip water. Eat a little if you have not eaten, unless a doctor told you not to.
Ask someone to stay with you. Stand only when the room feels steady.
Use SOS or call a doctor if you faint, the chest hurts, speech is slurred, or one side is weak.

string-array.name: care_weak_steps
string-array.item: Sit down. Do not walk far alone.
Sip water. If you take sugar medicines, check sugar the way your doctor taught you.
Tell a family member. Rest.
Call a doctor if you sweat a lot, shake, feel confused, or cannot stand.

string-array.name: care_fall_steps
string-array.item: Stay still for a moment. Check if the head, neck, or hip hurts badly.
If you can, roll to your side, then sit up slowly. Hold a chair or wall.
If you cannot get up, call out, use SOS, or phone family. Do not force a broken-feeling limb.
See a doctor after any fall that hits the head, if you feel dizzy, or you cannot bear weight.

string-array.name: care_chest_steps
string-array.item: Sit still. Loosen tight clothes. Do not walk around.
Tell someone nearby. Use SOS or call local emergency services now.
If your doctor already gave you a heart tablet for this, take only that, as they taught you.
Stay sitting until help arrives.

string-array.name: care_breath_steps
string-array.item: Sit upright. Open a window if the air is stuffy. Loosen the collar.
Breathe in slowly through the nose, out through the mouth.
Use SOS or local emergency services if breathing stays hard, the lips look blue, or you feel faint.
If you have an inhaler your doctor gave you, use it the way they taught you.

string-array.name: care_unwell_steps
string-array.item: Sit or lie down. Rest. Loosen tight clothes.
Sip water. Note what you feel: pain, fever, dizziness, or something else.
Tell a family member. Take only medicine your doctor already gave you for this, as they told you.
Call a doctor if this gets worse, lasts, or you feel unsure. Use SOS for sudden chest pain, fainting, or if you cannot breathe.
